meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 你说要清理死代码时，它会并行扫描项目，找出未引用的文件与符号，再用 LSP 引用查找逐个验证，确认后按文件分批交给多个后台代理删除并分别提交。最后跑类型检查、测试和构建并出报告。
howto.when: 当请求中包含「remove dead code」「dead code」或「cleanup」等触发词，或用户明确要清理死代码时生效；可指定文件、目录或符号名来限定扫描，不指定则默认扫全项目。

say.text: 请清理这个项目里的死代码。
say.note: 会启动全项目扫描，验证并删除，再逐批提交。

say.text: 只清理 src/legacy 目录下的无用代码。
say.note: 扫描范围会限定在该目录。

say.text: 看看 utils.ts 里有没有未使用的导入，删掉它们。
say.note: 只扫描该文件，移掉未使用的导入。

howto.what_en: Claude removes dead code: scans candidates in parallel, verifies each with LspFindReferences, batches by file, delegates each batch to background agents that delete and commit per batch, then runs typecheck/test/build and reports.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'remove dead code', 'dead code', 'cleanup', etc., or cleanup requests. A file/directory/symbol argument narrows the scan; default is whole project.

say_en.text: Please clean up dead code in this project.
say_en.note: It scans the whole project, verifies, then deletes in batches.

say_en.text: Only clean up dead code under src/legacy.
say_en.note: The scan is scoped to that directory.

say_en.text: Check utils.ts for unused imports and remove them.
say_en.note: Only that file is scanned and cleaned.
